name: Data Warehousing & Dimensional Modeling
description: Dimensional data modeling (Kimball & Inmon), Star and Snowflake schemas, Fact and Dimension design, Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), and Cloud Data Warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

subskills.name: Dimensional Modeling & Star/Snowflake Schemas
subskills.description: Kimball methodology, Star schema vs Snowflake schema, normalized vs denormalized analytical modeling, and grain definition.

subskills.name: Fact & Dimension Table Architecture
subskills.description: Transaction, Periodic Snapshot, and Accumulating Snapshot fact tables, Degenerate, Junk, Role-Playing, and Conformed dimensions.

subskills.name: Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Types 0-6)
subskills.description: Designing and implementing SCD Type 1 (overwrite), Type 2 (historical versioning with valid_from/valid_to/is_current), Type 3 (previous column), and hybrid types.

subskills.name: Snowflake Cloud Warehouse Architecture
subskills.description: Multi-cluster shared data architecture, virtual warehouses, auto-suspend/resume, zero-copy cloning, time travel, fail-safe, and micro-partitions.

subskills.name: Google BigQuery Serverless Warehouse
subskills.description: Dremel execution engine, Capacitor storage, slot allocation, partitioning by date/integer, clustering, BI Engine, and reservation management.

subskills.name: AWS Redshift & Distributed Storage
subskills.description: Leader vs Compute nodes, distribution styles (KEY, ALL, EVEN, AUTO), sort keys (compound vs interleaved), vacuum, and Redshift Serverless.

subskills.name: Columnar Storage Formats & Compression Encoding
subskills.description: Columnar projection, dictionary encoding, run-length encoding (RLE), ZSTD, Snappy, and I/O minimization during aggregation.

subskills.name: Semantic Layers & Metric Store Architecture
subskills.description: Building centralized semantic layers, consistent business metrics definition, Cube.js, dbt Semantic Layer, and BI integration.

subskills.name: Warehouse Cost Optimization & Workload Management
subskills.description: Monitoring compute consumption, query tagging, warehouse sizing, auto-scaling policies, query queuing, and FinOps for data warehouses.

cv.signal: Designed enterprise star-schema data models and managed Snowflake/BigQuery warehouses

linkedin.signal: Certified Data Warehouse Specialist or Snowflake SnowPro Core

assessment.signal: Passes Data Warehousing and Dimensional Modeling Architecture Assessment

junior.description: Models star/snowflake schemas, designs fact and dimension tables, and implements SCD Type 1 & 2 logic.

mid.description: Configures and manages cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery), tunes clustering, and optimizes columnar storage compression.

senior.description: Architects multi-warehouse enterprise topologies, establishes unified semantic metric layers, and governs warehouse compute costs.
